import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static String toString(String s) {
        return "\"" + s + "\"";
    }

    static String toString(char[] s) {
        return toString(new String(s));
    }

    static String toString(boolean b) {
        return b ? "true" : "false";
    }

    static String toString(List<Boolean> v) {
        boolean first = true;
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder("{");
        for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); i++) {
            if (!first) {
                res.append(", ");
            }
            first = false;
            res.append(toString(v.get(i)));
        }
        res.append("}");
        return res.toString();
    }

    static String toString(BitSet v, int N) {
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            res.append(v.get(i) ? '1' : '0');
        }
        return res.toString();
    }

    static <A> String toString(List<A> v) {
        boolean first = true;
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder("{");
        for (A x : v) {
            if (!first) {
                res.append(", ");
            }
            first = false;
            res.append(toString(x));
        }
        res.append("}");
        return res.toString();
    }

    static <A, B> String toString(Pair<A, B> p) {
        return "(" + toString(p.first) + ", " + toString(p.second) + ")";
    }

    static <A, B, C> String toString(Tuple3<A, B, C> p) {
        return "(" + toString(p.first) + ", " + toString(p.second) + ", " + toString(p.third) + ")";
    }

    static <A, B, C, D> String toString(Tuple4<A, B, C, D> p) {
        return "(" + toString(p.first) + ", " + toString(p.second) + ", " + toString(p.third) + ", " + toString(p.fourth) + ")";
    }

    static void debugOut(Object... args) {
        // No equivalent of cerr in Java, so just ignore or print to System.err
        System.err.println(Arrays.deepToString(args));
    }

    static class Pair<A, B> {
        A first;
        B second;
        Pair(A a, B b) {
            first = a;
            second = b;
        }
    }

    static class Tuple3<A, B, C> {
        A first;
        B second;
        C third;
        Tuple3(A a, B b, C c) {
            first = a;
            second = b;
            third = c;
        }
    }

    static class Tuple4<A, B, C, D> {
        A first;
        B second;
        C third;
        D fourth;
        Tuple4(A a, B b, C c, D d) {
            first = a;
            second = b;
            third = c;
            fourth = d;
        }
    }

    static <T> T inverse(T a, T m) {
        // Implement extended Euclidean algorithm for modular inverse
        // Since T can be Integer, Long, etc., handle accordingly
        if (a instanceof Integer && m instanceof Integer) {
            int aa = (Integer) a;
            int mm = (Integer) m;
            int u = 0, v = 1;
            int a_ = aa, m_ = mm;
            while (a_ != 0) {
                int t = m_ / a_;
                int temp = m_;
                m_ -= t * a_;
                m_ = a_;
                a_ = temp;
                int tempU = u;
                u -= t * v;
                u = v;
                v = tempU;
            }
            if (m_ != 1) throw new ArithmeticException("No inverse");
            if (u < 0) u += (Integer) m;
            return (T) Integer.valueOf(u);
        } else if (a instanceof Long && m instanceof Long) {
            long aa = (Long) a;
            long mm = (Long) m;
            long u = 0, v = 1;
            long a_ = aa, m_ = mm;
            while (a_ != 0) {
                long t = m_ / a_;
                long temp = m_;
                m_ -= t * a_;
                m_ = a_;
                a_ = temp;
                long tempU = u;
                u -= t * v;
                u = v;
                v = tempU;
            }
            if (m_ != 1) throw new ArithmeticException("No inverse");
            if (u < 0) u += (Long) m;
            return (T) Long.valueOf(u);
        } else {
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Inverse not implemented for type");
        }
    }

    static class Modular<T> {
        T value;
        static int mod;

        Modular() {
            // default constructor
        }

        <U> Modular(U x) {
            value = normalize(x);
        }

        static <U> int normalize(U x) {
            if (x instanceof Integer) {
                int v = (Integer) x;
                v %= mod;
                if (v < 0) v += mod;
                return v;
            } else if (x instanceof Long) {
                long v = (Long) x;
                v %= mod;
                if (v < 0) v += mod;
                return (int) v;
            } else {
                throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Normalization not implemented for type");
            }
        }

        int getValue() {
            return (Integer) value;
        }

        <U> U toU() {
            if (value instanceof Integer) {
                return (U) Integer.valueOf((Integer) value);
            } else if (value instanceof Long) {
                return (U) Long.valueOf((Long) value);
            } else {
                throw new UnsupportedOperationException("toU not implemented for type");
            }
        }

        static int mod() {
            return mod;
        }

        Modular add(Modular other) {
            int newVal = getValue() + other.getValue();
            if (newVal >= mod) newVal -= mod;
            this.value = (T) Integer.valueOf(newVal);
            return this;
        }

        Modular subtract(Modular other) {
            int newVal = getValue() - other.getValue();
            if (newVal < 0) newVal += mod;
            this.value = (T) Integer.valueOf(newVal);
            return this;
        }

        Modular multiply(Modular other) {
            int a = getValue();
            int b = other.getValue();
            long res = (long) a * b;
            res %= mod;
            this.value = (T) Integer.valueOf((int) res);
            return this;
        }

        Modular divide(Modular other) {
            return multiply(new Modular(inverse(other.getValue(), mod)));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Modular)) return false;
            Modular<?> modular = (Modular<?>) o;
            return getValue() == modular.getValue();
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(getValue());
        }
    }

    static class Power {
        static <T> Modular<T> power(Modular<T> a, long b) {
            if (b < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative exponent");
            Modular<T> res = new Modular<>(1);
            Modular<T> x = a;
            long p = b;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(x);
                x = x.multiply(x);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int md = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Modular.mod = md;
        List<Modular<Integer>> fact = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Modular<Integer>> inv_fact = new ArrayList<>();
        fact.add(new Modular<>(1));
        inv_fact.add(new Modular<>(1));
        // Caching factorials
        java.util.function.BiFunction<Integer, Integer, Modular<Integer>> C = (x, y) -> {
            int sz = Math.max(x, y);
            while (fact.size() <= sz) {
                int next = fact.size();
                fact.add(fact.get(fact.size() - 1).multiply(new Modular<>(next)));
                inv_fact.add(new Modular<>(inverse(fact.get(fact.size() - 1).getValue(), Modular.mod())));
            }
            if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Modular<>(0);
            return fact.get(x).multiply(inv_fact.get(y)).multiply(inv_fact.get(x - y));
        };

        List<Modular<Integer>> ptr_dp = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m + 1, new Modular<>(0)));
        List<Modular<Integer>> ptr_ways = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m + 1, new Modular<>(0)));
        ptr_ways.set(0, new Modular<>(1));

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            Modular<Integer> sumWays = new Modular<>(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular<Integer> c = C.apply(l + r, l);
                Modular<Integer> add = new Modular<>((l + r + 2));
                sumWays = sumWays.add(ptr_ways.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r)).multiply(c).multiply(add));
            }
            ptr_ways.set(i, sumWays);
            Modular<Integer> sumDp = new Modular<>(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular<Integer> c = C.apply(l + r, l);
                Modular<Integer> add = new Modular<>((l + r + 2));
                Modular<Integer> term1 = ptr_ways.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r)).multiply(c).multiply(add);
                Modular<Integer> term2 = ptr_dp.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r)).add(ptr_dp.get(r).multiply(ptr_ways.get(l))).multiply(c).multiply(new Modular<>(l + r + 2));
                sumDp = sumDp.add(term1).add(term2);
            }
            ptr_dp.set(i, sumDp);
        }

        Modular<Integer>[][] dp = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        Modular<Integer>[][] ways = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], new Modular<>(0));
            Arrays.fill(ways[i], new Modular<>(0));
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Modular<>(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptr_dp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptr_ways.get(s);
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    if (i - d >= 0 && s + 1 - d >= 0) {
                        Modular<Integer> ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                        Modular<Integer> way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                        int add = d - 1;
                        ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptr_ways.get(add)).multiply(C.apply(s, add)));
                        dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptr_dp.get(add)).add(ptr_ways.get(add).multiply(ft)).multiply(C.apply(s, add)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m].getValue());
    }
}
